title: Red Hat Security Advisory: glib2 security update
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the xdgmime component of GLib, specifically in the _xdg_mime_magic_parse_magic_line() function. This issue is identified as CVE-2026-16118 and affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.8 variants. The vulnerability has been rated as moderate severity by Red Hat Product Security. A security update addressing this flaw is available from Red Hat.
